scripts.reset: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules .turbo apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo apps/expo/.expo apps/expo/.netlify apps/expo/.tamagui apps/expo/dist apps/expo/android/build apps/expo/ios/build apps/expo/.next **/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo **/.DS_Store && pnpm store prune && echo '✅ Cache cleared! Run pnpm install to reinstall dependencies.'
scripts.reset:full: pnpm reset && rm -rf apps/expo/android apps/expo/ios && echo '✅ Full reset complete! Run pnpm prebuild to regenerate native directories.'
scripts.supa:config:push: pnpm env-local pnpx supabase --workdir packages config push
scripts.supa:config:push:prod: pnpm env-prod pnpx supabase --workdir packages config push
scripts.supa:functions:prod: pnpm supa:prod functions deploy trpc --project-ref qmfmpcyxsihhfttvqpbw
scripts.supa:reset: pnpm supa db reset && pnpm supa seed && pnpm test
scripts.supa:generate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpx supabase --workdir packages gen types typescript --local > packages/supabase/types.ts
scripts.test:build: pnpm build && echo '✅ All packages built successfully'
scripts.test:lint: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check-deps
scripts.test:integration: pnpm test:deps && pnpm test:lint && pnpm test:tamagui
scripts.validate:migration: pnpm test:all && echo '✅ Migration validation complete'
